\title{Pseudo-Hermitian Geometry}
\section{Preliminaries}
Let $M^{2m+1}$ be a smooth orientable manifold. A *CR structure* is a complex rank-$m$ subbundle $H^{1,0}\subset TM\otimes\mathbb C$.

\begin{align}
H^{1,0}\cap H^{0,1}&=\{0\},\\
[\Gamma(H^{1,0}),\Gamma(H^{1,0})]&\subseteq\Gamma(H^{1,0}).\label{eq:integrable}
\end{align}

\begin{remark}
The horizontal distribution is $H=\Re(H^{1,0}\oplus H^{0,1})$.
\end{remark}

\section{Levi Form}
The Levi form is defined by
\begin{equation}
L_\theta(X,Y)=d\theta(X,J_bY).\label{eq:levi}
\end{equation}

The Sasakian case is discussed in [[Sas]].
